title: Engine metrics v2 (Release C, telemetry SPEC)
description: Hourly engine metric buckets (POST /v1/metrics/hours, signed by the instance key), the sharing state (GET /v1/metrics/sharing, POST /v1/metrics/sharing/confirm, W104), the Insights responses (W99 workspace, W100 company, GET /v1/metrics/insights for the engine), export (W101), delete (W102; engine DELETE /v1/metrics/hours) and settings (W103). Aggregated counters only: never content, paths, prompts, model output, secret values, command lines or free text; unknown members are refused. Bucket key (instance from the bearer token, hour, vault); a higher rev replaces the hour. Retention: until the account is deleted or the customer deletes it. Gate: policy member sharing.share_engine_metrics (false_wins, server) and the plan default.

point.description: start of an hourly, daily (T00:00:00Z) or weekly (Monday T00:00:00Z) point

tool.description: closed registry: the engine's KNOWN_TOOLS (lean-ctx-protocol metrics_v2); anything else is `other`

rule.description: closed registry: a policy member path or a gateway rule id; anything else is `other`

filter.description: closed registry: a read mode or an output class; anything else is `other`

host.description: closed registry: the engine's KNOWN_HOSTS (MCP client ids); anything else is `other`

provider.description: closed registry: the engine's KNOWN_PROVIDERS; anything else is `other`

model.description: closed registry: the engine's KNOWN_MODELS (price-table keys); anything else (fine-tuned, custom) is `other`

name.description: the engine's WireName rule: a known host, provider or model, or `other` (host/provider/model fields use their own narrower registries)

program.description: closed registry of known programs; never a command line

host_family.description: closed registry: the engine's HOST_FAMILIES (agent host families, from the MCP client id); anything else is `other`

name.description: an MCP server named in the workspace's own signed policy (allowed/denied tool entries) or `other`; never a hash and never a run of 24+ letters or digits (token-like); Hive refuses any other name (x-server)

secret_row.description: K21 after the K2 review (H1): redactions per detector only; no fingerprint or any other value-derived datum leaves the device

slice.description: counters of one engine, one UTC hour, one vault: absolute values for the hour, not deltas

vault.description: Hive vault id; null = work outside every vault of the workspace, accepted only by a Personal workspace

tokens.description: input = baseline tokens without LeanCTX (estimate), output = tokens delivered (counted), saved = input - output

savings.description: K7/K8 own savings by trust class: measured + estimated = saved (estimated with its low/high range), evidenced = part backed by receipt or provider reconciliation, overhead = tokens LeanCTX itself added (instructions, schemas, hints); net own savings = measured + estimated - overhead (may be negative); the provider cache is ledger.cache_discount, never part of it

read_modes.description: ctx_read calls per read mode (closed set; unknown modes count as other)

tools.description: unique tool; beyond 47 rows the rest merges into `other`

policy_blocks.description: K12: per rule, refusals in force (blocked) and refusals a rule in monitor mode would make (would_block)

refetch.description: K10: per filter (read mode or compression pattern name), outputs truncated and fetched back in full by the agent

unregulated.description: K13: activity no rule covers, by kind and name; program = a name of the engine's known-program table, never a command line; anything else is `other`

secret_hits.description: K21: redactions per secret detector; never the value or anything derived from it

spend.description: measured model spend only; list price, never an invoice

hive.description: X4 Hive help, hourly (moved from v1 POST /v1/metrics, which is retired): facts delivered and then used, median time to the first Hive context over first_context_sessions sessions (null with none), ledger usage per claimed task

task_usage.description: per Hive task number (an integer id, never a title), sorted, unique

gauges.description: levels at the end of the hour (or at sending time for the current hour)

rev.description: grows per (engine, hour) each time the engine rebuilds the hour; Hive keeps the highest

hours_request.description: POST /v1/metrics/hours body, at most 512 KiB; the instance is the bearer token's; counts against the transfer quota

key_id.description: the enrolled instance key (must be the bearer token's instance)

refusal.description: one refused slice (vault set) or bucket (too_old/future/before_sharing: vault null); level names who turned the rule off for policy_denied

hours_ack.description: accepted/unchanged count buckets; a bucket with some refused slices is accepted with the rest

sharing_state.description: whether this engine (engine routes) or this workspace (web) shares metrics now; policy = the level that set sharing.share_engine_metrics (null: no level sets it); since = start of the current sharing period: no hour before it is sent or accepted

plan_default.description: Team and Business: on; Community and Pro: off until the person confirms once

person.description: pseudonymised by default; name only when names_visible

ref.description: stable pseudonymous id per workspace (HMAC of the user id); filters use it

label.description: the name when names are visible, else a pseudonym (`Person 4F2A`); `You` for the caller

metrics.description: flat metric names (SPEC §1.2); sums except knowledge.facts_current (gauge) and engines.active (distinct engines, derived)

labels.description: K7 trust label of every metric (SPEC §1.2 table); the same on every response

delta.description: abs = current - previous; pct = abs / previous x 100 (one decimal), null when previous is 0

label.description: the engine label when names are visible or it is the caller's, else a pseudonym (`Engine 2C9E`)

filters.description: the engine route accepts engine=self (the calling instance); totals are exact integer sums of the stored buckets (K24 parity)

engines.description: every engine of the scope the caller may see (same visibility as rows), with its sharing state

series.description: oldest first, one point per resolution step, empty points included

rows.description: empty for group=total; only rows the caller's role may see (SPEC §7)

prices.description: list prices Hive estimates cost and model conversion with (K23); the same table the engine's Numbers explained shows

coverage_engine.description: one engine of the scope; workspace is set in company scope; level names who switched sharing off

price_row.description: USD micros per 1M tokens, list price

field_list.description: K1 fixed field list and K9 formulas: records/metrics_fields.json

fields.description: every member a slice may carry (K1); anything else is refused

metrics.description: every flat metric with its formula (K9 Numbers explained, shared by the engine and Hive)

export_line.description: W101 one JSONL line per (hour, engine, vault); CSV has the same columns with metrics flattened to their names; labels pseudonymised unless names are visible

delete_response.description: W102 and engine DELETE /v1/metrics/hours (every bucket of the calling instance)

insights_settings.description: W103 response; PUT body has person_names and/or budget_usd_micros (K23 monthly budget line, null = none)

person_names.description: false (default): people and engines are pseudonymised in every view and export
